text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: As I'm walking by the front gate of the academy, I spot Air Groove and Tokai Teio.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Oho, looks like this party has a new guest! Come join us!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Who said you could invite anyone?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: She's been moaning all day about how bored she is without the president around.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: I attempted to remove her from the premises, but she ended up dragging me out here with her.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: C'mon, just give it up and hang out with me already! Let's goooo!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: H-hold on, I didn't agree to any of this! Let go of me!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: And here we are! All right, Air Groove. Time to duke it out!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Fine. Just one round, and then I'll be going.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Ooh, I know. Your trainer can decide what we play! How about it?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: You prob'ly don't play games like this a lot, so it's fairer if I let you guys choose!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Hah. As if I need any favors.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: What game should I pick?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Ooh! You sure? I'm pretty good at those, if I do say so myself!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: I won't back down in the face of a challenge. Bring it, Tokai Teio.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Hehe, gotcha. I'm not holdin' back then!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Woohoo, a perfect score on the bonus stage too!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Tokai Teio's footwork is incredible…

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Heh, how do ya like that, Air Groove? No way you can beat that score!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Huh, wait… Where's Air Groove? Is she still playing?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I was so absorbed in Tokai Teio's dancing that I forgot about Air Groove. I frantically look for her and find…

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: What's the matter with you?! Where are your manners?!

text_block_list.name: Passerby A
text_block_list.text: Don't be like that, gorgeous! Your dancing just looked so great, I couldn't stop staring!

text_block_list.name: Passerby B
text_block_list.text: You gotta show us those hot moves again. I'll even pay for it! It's what you came here for, right? What's the problem?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I instinctively move to get between them. However, before I'm able to reach Air Groove, someone else leaps to action.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Get! Away! From! Her!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: What's wrong with you two?! Don't you know better than to bother people who're just trying to have fun?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Besides, it's me you should be watching, not her! I put on a way better show!

text_block_list.name: Passerby A
text_block_list.text: C-come on, dude, let's bail… Short stack's totally killed the mood.

text_block_list.name: Passerby B
text_block_list.text: You said it. See ya later, pipsqueak!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: H-hold it! Who're you callin' pipsqueak?! Talk about rude!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Grrr… And don't get me started on you, Air Groove!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: What did I do?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: It's what you didn't do that's the problem! Where was the scary Air Groove who always yells at me?!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Just today, you were giving me that look of yours with your eyebrow raised all the way to here!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: They're complete strangers. I can't treat them the same way I treat you.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: That shouldn't matter! Ugh, why don't you get it?! Sheesh!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Hold on… Are you… telling me off right now?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Am I actually being told off by Teio? Talk about ridiculous… Haha… Ahahah!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Come ON! First them, now you? Stop laughing when I'm trying to be serious!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: I-I'm sorry, it's just… Pfft… I really can't… Hahahaha!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Air Groove can't help but laugh at the bizarre predicament she's found herself in.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Ah, a game of knowledge and stratagems. Yes, I think this might be fun.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Heh, well… I'm no pushover when it comes to games that use your brains!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Very well. Before we begin, I'd like to study the features and abilities of the cards. Wait just a moment, Teio.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Take as long as you need! Imma go try the claw machine in the meantime.
choice_data_list: Don't you need to get ready too?
Don't you need to get ready too?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: I've played this game loads of times. I've just about memorized all the cards.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: No point gettin' all worked up about it!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: That should be enough. Thank you for waiting, Teio. I'm ready now.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: I scored twenty pieces of candy while waiting, so it's all good.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: All righty then! Let's get this game started!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The duel begins, and Tokai Teio quickly gains the upper hand.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Heh, drawing this out isn't fun for anyone. It's time to end this!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Oho… You have both the knowledge and daring to strike when necessary. I imagine the average player wouldn't stand a chance against you.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Haha, here's somethin' you don't see every day! Is the high and mighty Air Groove givin' up?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: No, Teio. I said the average player.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: I certainly hope you're not counting the Empress among their ranks!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Now, prepare to feel my army's wrath!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: (Zhwooooom!)

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: N-nooooo!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: I… I lost?! But how?!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Hubris got the best of you. You believed you had an advantage over your opponent in experience, expertise, and even innate ability.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: This combination was the source of your carelessness—and by extension, your defeat.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: …Careless? Me?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: …I'm gonna review all the cards again. You'd better sit tight, 'cause we're having a rematch!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Oh?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: You may be the Empress, but I'm the Monarch!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: I refuse to accept anything other than a clean sweep!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Very well. I'll humor you.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Hmph, just you wait!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Heh.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: …For once, I agree.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And so, much to her enjoyment, Air Groove spends a little more time matching wits against Tokai Teio.
